decisions.reason: Its promotion from a website mention in 2023 to the home page in 2024 signals rising public commitment and a strong fit with care-related services, making management likely to justify continued support and treat any weakness as temporary.
Because it stayed on the home page in both 2023 and 2024 and is closely tied to the firm's senior-care core, management is strongly committed and unlikely to withdraw it soon.

Although more peripheral than direct care, the move from a website mention to the home page suggests growing reputational and resource commitment, which under escalation of commitment favors continuation.
This is the least publicly committed product so far, but as a newly launched and adjacent senior service management can still attribute mixed results to start-up effects and keep it running for now.
